title: Fake Death Disintegration
next_chapter_hook: When all retreat paths are sealed, when all disguises are torn away, Chen Ji finally doesn't have to hide anymore—it's time to show the world what a true废物 of the Tianqing Sect looks like.

text.content:
The aftershock of the ruin's collapse had not yet dissipated, Chen Ji knelt on the ruins, his blood seemingly frozen into ice by that cold voice. 'Your fate was written the moment you were born'—the voice of the Ruins' Master echoed in his Mental Sea, like a curse.

He lowered his head to look at his own hands, pale skin with veins faintly pulsing beneath. Heavenly Fate: 87. At this moment, he suddenly wanted to laugh. So from the very beginning, he had been a marionette, not even qualified to struggle—it was all permitted. 

But in the next instant, that chill was pressed into the deepest part of his heart. So what if he's a marionette? If the strings break, the puppet might not die—it might learn to walk on its own.

A violent dizziness struck, Chen Ji braced himself against the broken stone pillar to barely stabilize. The Tianji Record Fragment in his spirit platform shook frantically, as if sensing something. He closed his eyes, his divine sense probing deep into his Mental Sea—

'Young Master, terrible news!' The phantom materialized by Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul showed such grave expression for the first time, 'All seventeen hidden strongholds you established in the Tianqing Sect were eliminated at the third watch this morning! That old scoundrel Ling Yuan used the sect's reserves, the Tianji Mirror revealed every disciple secretly connected to you!'

Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, pupils contracting sharply. The third watch—that was precisely when he entered the ruins' core.

dialogue.content: 'What's even more troublesome is that the fake death formation you so carefully prepared... has been破解from the outside.' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried rare urgency, 'Someone used reversal technique to find your original hiding spot. Ling Yuan has already confirmed that you are still alive.'

text.content:
Chen Ji slowly straightened up, brushing the dust off his robes, his movements so calm it was chilling. 'Reversal technique...' he softly repeated these words, his mind racing through every person he knew who could perform such forbidden arts.

Those who could破解the formation he personally arranged, while also having connections with Ling Yuan—fewer than three. And the most likely among them—

'Han Lie.' He spat out this name, yet a cold smirk actually curled at the corner of his mouth, 'A genius of the Xuanwu Sect, actually willing to be a dog for the old fox of Tianqing Sect. Interesting.'

In the Mental Sea, the Tianji Record Fragment glowed faintly, a prophetic vision slowly emerging: Three days later, in the main hall of Tianqing Sect, Ling Yuan and Han Lie stood shoulder to shoulder, the golden-lettered bounty of the joint pursuit order suspended in midair—a full three thousand jin of superior spirit stones, plus three breakthrough pills.

The pursuit target wrote two large characters: Chen Ji.

But even more blinding was a line of small text beneath the pursuit order—'Anyone who colludes with this beast shall be punished as an accomplice.'

Chen Ji stared at that line for three breaths, then suddenly laughed softly. The laughter was faint, yet carried an inexplicable chill. Ling Yuan's move was truly ruthless—not only wanting to kill him, but also severing all his connections and retreat paths.

choice.prompt: Fake Death Disintegration, various forces are about to锁定your position, you must make a choice—

choices.text: Strike first, disrupt the pursuit order
choices.description: Before the pursuit order is officially issued, first expose Ling Yuan's leverage to the public, disrupting their rhythm
choices.visible_reward: Pursuit order release delayed by three days
choices.risk_hint: The Substitute Talisman is the last lifeblood trump card, once used it's gone

text.content: Chen Ji drew out a Substitute Talisman glowing with eerie light from his sleeve—this was the final lifeblood item Mo Xiansheng left him. He injected his divine sense imprint into the talisman, lowering his voice: 'Send this to the Xuanwu Sect, say it's a 'gift' from the Tianqing Sect to Han Lie.' The Substitute Talisman dissolved into streaming light vanishing from his fingertips.

choices.text: Return to stronghold to transfer core assets
choices.description: While enemies haven't fully surrounded, personally return to transfer resources and intelligence accumulated over years
choices.visible_reward: Preserve three years of accumulated resources and connections
choices.risk_hint: Since Ling Yuan confirmed you were in the ruins, he likely set an ambush near your stronghold

text.content: Chen Ji transformed into a streak of escaping light, streaking toward his secret stronghold. However, just as he approached, the Tianji Record suddenly gave a sharp warning—before him lay at least five Transformed God realm auras in ambush, along with a faint Hollow Void realm pressure. His pupils contracted slightly: 'Ling Yuan, you old fox, you were indeed waiting for me.'

choices.description: Openly appear before Ling Yuan, drawing all pursuers' attention to yourself, buying time for those operating in the shadows
choices.visible_cost: Become the target of all attacks
choices.risk_hint: Once exposed, face relentless pursuit in the short term

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his escape light and instead swaggered toward the nearest market town. He deliberately released a trace of aura within the range that the Tianji Mirror could sense—if he was going to act, he'd do it completely. Soon, several sharp divine senses chased after him like bones clinging to flesh. "Come chase me then." He sneered in his heart.

"Meanwhile, in the Tianqing Sect Council Hall, Ling Yuan sat upright at the main seat, with Han Lie standing below with an arrogant expression. Between them floated an ancient bronze mirror, reflecting the scene of Chen Ji walking out of the ruins.

"This waste actually survived coming out of there?" Han Lie frowned, a trace of wariness flickering in his eyes. He had witnessed the ruins' terror firsthand—the place had swallowed three Xuanwu Sect elders, leaving nothing behind.

Ling Yuan's aged face revealed a cold, sinister smile: "So what if he survived? His faked death trick has been exposed. The Tianji Mirror has revealed all his arrangements—seventeen hidden bases, thirty-six contact points, and an intelligence network spanning three years."

dialogue.content: "Three years?" An incredulous light flashed in Han Lie's eyes. "A servant disciple, spending three years setting up such a massive scheme?" He suddenly recalled how he had repeatedly boasted of his strength before Chen Ji and mocked him as waste—those scenes, now replaying in his mind, made his back grow slightly cold.

text.content:
Ling Yuan rose slowly, his withered fingers tracing a mystical symbol in the air. "The joint hunt order has been drafted. Three thousand jin of superior spirit stones, three breakthrough pills, plus the favor of the Tianqing Sect—this reward will drive half the cultivation world into a frenzy."

He turned to look at Han Lie, his murky old eyes suddenly sharp. "Young Han, are you certain you wish to sign this hunt order? Remember, this means defying a member of the imperial family."

Han Lie coldly snorted. "And if I do? What's a mere imperial successor to the Xuanwu Sect? Besides—" A cruel smile twisted his lips, "This time, I personally want to snap that waste's neck."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji intercepted the hunt order news and discovered the crown prince was also implicated—

choices.text: Contact the crown prince to discuss countermeasures
choices.description: The crown prince was entangled due to his secret dealings with you, requiring immediate notification to stabilize the situation
choices.visible_cost: Expose the true relationship with the crown prince
choices.visible_reward: Obtain covert support from the imperial court
choices.risk_hint: The crown prince might have internal traitors; messages could potentially be intercepted

text.content: Chen Ji retrieved a transmission jade talisman carved with dragon patterns. After hesitating, he activated it. Moments later, the usually handsome but now anxious face of the crown prince appeared in the light screen: "Brother Chen, you finally contacted me! My imperial brother has had people surveilling me for three days—I'm barely holding on!"

choices.text: Sever ties with the crown prince, cutting off the tail to survive
choices.description: Actively cut all connections with the crown prince, removing the leverage of the hunt order's threat
choices.visible_reward: The hunt order's imperial involvement becomes meaningless
choices.risk_hint: The crown prince might resent you, losing a future valuable connection

text.content: Chen Ji stared at the dragon-patterned jade talisman, silent for ten full breaths. Finally, he crushed the talisman into powder, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes: "I'm sorry. You shouldn't be dragged into the murky waters of the imperial court." He turned, his robes billowing as he made his decision.

Tianqing Sect's news spread at astonishing speed. When the fact that "waste Chen Ji is still alive" was confirmed, countless people wore expressions of disbelief.

Three years ago, when Chen Ji "died" in the beast tide, the entire Tianqing Sect had mocked this overreaching servant disciple. Some said he deserved it, others called him foolish, and more had long forgotten his name.

But now, those who had mocked Chen Ji suddenly realized—the waste in their eyes seemed to have been scheming from the very beginning. Seventeen hidden bases, thirty-six contact points, a three-year intelligence network... This was no waste at all! He was clearly a dormant beast awakening!

dialogue.content: When the hunt order was officially released, Ling Yuan stood atop the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate, gazing down at the murmuring disciples below. His aged voice echoed across the grounds: "Chen Ji, this child, has betrayed his sect and secretly connected with the demonic path—his crimes are unforgivable! Whoever slays this villain shall be rewarded with three thousand jin of superior spirit stones and three breakthrough pills! I shall personally take him as my direct disciple!"

text.content:
A sudden commotion erupted among the crowd. Ling Yuan personally taking someone as a disciple? The conditions were extraordinarily generous! Why would the Tianqing Sect leader offer such a sky-high price for a "unforgivable" waste disciple?

Only a few knew the truth—Ling Yuan was fishing. He understood Chen Ji's value too well. That child chosen by the Tianji Record must be hiding a massive secret. No price was too high to capture him alive.

In a remote cave dwelling of the Tianqing Sect, Su Qingyao abruptly stood up, her beautiful eyes wide with shock and confusion. She stared fixedly at the hunt order jade slip in her hand, its words cutting into her heart like sharp blades. "Chen Ji... you're still alive?" Her voice trembled slightly. "Why... how many things have you been hiding from me?"

choice.prompt: The hunt order spread across the world, and Su Qingyao also learned the truth—she was trying to contact you—

choices.description: She is the only person you trusted, and the most likely to understand the truth
choices.visible_reward: Gain Su Qingyao's understanding and support

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then finally activated the dedicated communication jade slip with Su Qingyao. Her voice came through almost instantly, carrying a suppressed tremor: "Chen Ji! Tell me, everything from these three years was a lie! You're not a废物, you—who exactly are you?"

choices.description: Now is not the time to reveal more trump cards—the less she knows, the safer she will be
choices.visible_reward: Preserve the last hidden trump card

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at the flickering communication request on the jade slip, his hand hovering mid-air,迟迟没有按下. He closed his eyes, feeling a faint ache in some soft corner of his heart: "Sorry, Qingyao. Telling you now would only put you in danger." He tucked the jade slip into his sleeve and vanished into the night.

choices.text: Appear proactively, draw her into the scheme
choices.description: Pull her into your plan, make her part of the chess game
choices.risk_hint: She will face Ling Yuan's suspicion

text.content: Chen Ji connected the communication, staring directly into Su Qingyao's reddened eyes: "You want to know the truth? Fine, I'll tell you. But once you hear it, there will be no turning back." His voice was soft, yet carried an undeniable weight. Su Qingyao bit her lip and nodded firmly. "Alright."

Chen Ji stood atop an unnamed mountain peak, overlooking the countless lights below. The kill order had been issued three days ago, and the entire cultivation world was frantically searching for him. And he, like a spider lurking in the shadows, quietly wove a new web.

Did Ling Yuan really think that severing his hidden posts would render him blind? How naive. Those hidden posts were merely pieces on the surface. The true core assets had been dispersed and hidden three years ago to places even Mo Xiansheng didn't know.

"Old thing, you think you've already won?" Chen Ji murmured to himself, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of his lips. "Let me see exactly how long you can keep laughing."

He spread open his palm, the Tianji Record Fragment glowing faintly in his Mental Sea. The oppressive aura of the Void Refining realm slowly emanated from his body—that was his greatest gain from the ruins. Before leaving, the ruins' master had pushed him to this realm he originally would have needed another ten years to reach.

"Since hiding is no longer an option..." Chen Ji discarded all pretense, a fierce light flickering in his eyes, "then I won't hide anymore."

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul emerged from the depths of his Mental Sea. Gazing at the aura emanating from Chen Ji, he remained silently for a rare moment before speaking slowly: "Young Master, are you truly set on this? Once you confront them directly, there will be no path back."

Chen Ji didn't turn around, merely saying calmly: "I never had a path back. From the moment I obtained the Tianji Record, my path was only one direction—forward."

text.content:
Tianqing Sect, Council Hall.

Ling Yuan sat in the main seat, fingers tapping lightly on the armrest, his expression betraying no joy or anger. Han Lie stood beside him, his face阴沉如水—three days had passed, and they had dispatched hundreds of cultivators to search方圆万里, yet they hadn't found even a shadow of Chen Ji.

"How is this possible?" Han Lie ground his teeth, "Didn't we break his faked death formation? Didn't we eliminate those hidden posts? How could he possibly still have somewhere to hide?"

Ling Yuan's浑浊的老眼微微眯起, his voice hoarse: "It seems we all underestimated this废物." He rose, his withered figure appearing especially sinister under the candlelight, "But it doesn't matter. The deeper he hides, the bigger the secret he carries. Issue the order—send more people, turn over the entire Tianqing Sect territory!"

Just then, a disciple rushed into the hall, his expression panicked: "Sect Master! Something's wrong! Chen Ji... Chen Ji has appeared!"

Ling Yuan and Han Lie both changed colors. "Where?!"

"Tianqing Sect Outer Court Training Grounds!" The disciple's voice trembled, "He... he's standing alone in the center of the grounds, saying he wants—to challenge Senior Brother Han Lie!"

Han Lie froze, then let out a roar of furious laughter: "Good! Good! Good! A废物 actually dares to deliver himself to our door!" His blood qi surged, the Xuanwu True Intent erupting explosively, the hall's dome quaking under this oppressive aura, "This time, I'll tear apart that虚伪 face of his in front of the entire sect!"

However, Ling Yuan furrowed his brow, a flicker of unease crossing his eyes. Chen Ji's move was far too abnormal—a piece that had been hidden for three years, suddenly appearing openly to issue a challenge—there must be something here he hadn't seen through.

"Let's go." Ling Yuan rose, his voice gloomy, "Let's see what tricks this little mouse is up to."

When Ling Yuan and Han Lie arrived at the training grounds with numerous elders, what they saw left everyone stunned—

Chen Ji stood right there, alone, facing the endless sea of Tianqing Sect disciples. He made no attempt to hide his cultivation, the oppressive aura of the Void Refining realm pressing down heavily on everyone's hearts.

Those who had once mocked him now stared wide-eyed, as if seeing a ghost. Void Refining realm?! That废物 menial servant they had trampled beneath their feet was actually a Void Refining realm Great One?!

Chen Ji slowly raised his head, his gaze passing over the crowd and landing directly on Ling Yuan. A slight smile curved his lips, his voice clear and carrying across the entire grounds:

"Ling Sect Master, it's been three years. How have you been?"

Dead silence filled the area.

Then, Chen Ji lightly raised his hand, a brilliant sword glow shooting skyward, pointing directly at Ling Yuan:

"This junior comes today for only one purpose—the debt of you personally pushing me into the beast tide three years ago. Today, it's time to settle accounts."

With these words, the entire crowd erupted!

Beast tide three years ago? Pushed by the Sect Master personally? There was actually such an inside story?! Countless gazes of shock, doubt, and excitement flickered between Chen Ji and Ling Yuan.

Ling Yuan's expression instantly turned extremely阴沉. He never expected Chen Ji would expose this old grudge at this time, in this place, in front of everyone. The old fox's killing intent surged within, yet his face remained impassive as he coldly said: "Chen Ji, don't spout baseless accusations! Your death in the beast tide three years ago was an accident—what does it have to do with me?"

Chen Ji smiled, that smile as gentle as spring breeze, yet every word cut to the bone: "Is that so? Then does Ling Sect Master dare to swear on your Dao heart that you never made a move against me three years ago?"

Ling Yuan's expression shifted slightly. Swear on his Dao heart? He was a person negated by the Tianji Record—if he truly swore, he would likely suffer heavenly backlash on the spot!
